subject.title: [Bug]: delivery-recovery 0 recovered / N failed after gateway restart — recovery starts before channel transport ready

question: Should the remaining Feishu restart recovery work use a channel-owned reconnect drain, a gateway-wide readiness gate, or a retry-count reset policy?
rationale: Current source supports a Feishu readiness gap, but the durable fix shape affects channel ownership and retry semantics; automation should not choose a global startup or retry policy without maintainer intent and live Feishu proof.

options.title: Feishu-owned reconnect drain
options.body: Add a Feishu onReady/onReconnected drain for eligible Feishu queue entries, matching Telegram and WhatsApp while preserving current retry accounting.

options.title: Gateway-wide readiness gate
options.body: Delay generic startup recovery until configured channel transports report ready, which may reduce races but changes cross-channel startup behavior.

options.title: Retry reset policy
options.body: Reset retry counts across restart boundaries, which may avoid exhaustion but risks masking real permanent delivery failures.

recommendation.title: Feishu-owned reconnect drain
recommendation.body: Add a Feishu onReady/onReconnected drain for eligible Feishu queue entries, matching Telegram and WhatsApp while preserving current retry accounting.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest combined history across Feishu monitor transport and outbound delivery queue recovery.
